title: LabCraft-Eval: A stochastic agent evaluation environment for benign molecular-microbiology protocols
description: LabCraft-Eval is an Inspect AI evaluation environment for measuring how well AI agents execute benign molecular-microbiology protocols inside a seeded stochastic laboratory simulator, with deterministic multi-axis trajectory scoring, citation-backed task data, and manifest-backed public Hugging Face dataset exports. Source code is Apache-2.0; benchmark content under task_data/ and data/ is CC BY-NC 4.0.
